title_en: The Section on the Guru-Deva (the Divine Guru)
translit:
|| ath shri gurudevka ang ||

naam hamaro Jivana | kanbi kul avatar ||
sanyi hamara Ramji | sadguru Das Gopal ||1||
sadguru Das Gopalji | je Janak-vansh avatar ||
Raghupati batayo Jivana | je Vrushbhan-suta shangar ||2||
guru kije vicharke | jehi batave Ram ||
Sarayu tire Jivana | je nagar Ayodhya gam ||3||
sanyi hamara Ramji | jake Bharat Shatrughna bhrat ||
Sankarshan sang Janki | Jivan e jag tat ||4||
sadgurue samjayo Jivana | tab bhayo man dhir ||
pay payo deval firo | yun kahi Das Kabir ||5||
andekhi ansambhali | sadguru diya batay ||
ab nidra kyon sove Jivana | naam nirmal jara gay ||6||
lok ved sab jaan de | jaan de dharti akash ||
sadguru shabde raho Jivana | jahan prem bhakti prakash ||7||
eka eki mahasukhi | dooja sadguru bel ||
trija Raghupati Jivana | name karvi kel ||8||
kushal padi re Jivana | jab sadguru pakde hath ||
anek janam Ram naam bin | baval dini bath ||9||
bido chosath paanko | sadguru diyo batay ||
eh var magun Jivana | sant charan pasay ||10||
Ramanande je kahi | so suni Das Kabir ||
so sadguru kahi Jivana | bhaj Sitapati Raghuvir ||11||
tin lokmen tattva tha | so sadguru diya batay ||
kund atthavis Jivana | je janke diya chhoday ||12||
ola jhola Jivana | je sadguru diya batay ||
karma dharmamaan Raghupati | je vede dharya chhapay ||13||
baba badhu nav chhandiye | Yashoda kanth Kahan ||
sadguru samjhayo Jivana | to kaiso maan upmaan ||14||
ved virodh bhayo Jivana | jab sadguru bhaye sahay ||
ved kahe Niranjan bhajo | ham Raghuvar dulaho gay ||15||
janma safal kar Jivana | bhaj Sitapatiko naam ||
jot swaroop vede kahyo | pan saryo na eke kaam ||16||
koi nahi tera Jivana | main dekhyo desh videsh ||
Sitapatiko asaro | ke sadguruko updesh ||17||
guru bichara kaha kare | jo sikh bhaya gumar ||
khir kookarkun Jivana | pet na rahe lagar ||18||
harijan to honse thayo | guru malyo gumar ||
sarkhe sarkhun Jivana | jyun gadhdha lete chhar ||19||
dhire dhire Jivana | jyun haal kachindaa pay ||
ab desh chhodi vea liya | sadguru kaha je aavo ||20||
jam jootho padachyo Jivana | jab sadguru dini saakh ||
ehi tamaro aatma | Raghupati lije rakh ||21||
sadguru shabd sooli bhai | sant bhaye rakhval ||
jane na deu Jivana | niradhar kirtar ||22||

|| sakhi bhetki ||
sadguru hathilo Jivana | khele apno daav ||
jahan jahan aapa dekhiye | tahan tahan deve paav ||23||
saar liye sadguru khada | naam nishan bajay ||
aapa tharthar kampiya | so jahan Jivan tahan jay ||24||

|| sakhi shri mukhki ||
guru guru sab koy kahe | mite nahin sharir ||
shri mukh kahe sun Jivana | guru khetaiya vir ||25||
mido valo Jivana | jo karun aandevki sev ||
sadguru sat hi tattva kahyo | sache Raghupati dev ||26||
sadguruke updeshka | aradh naam pravesh ||
bhavsagar mitke Jivana | ham avenge un desh ||27||
Hari hindole Jivana | visaryo saghlo saath ||
kripa bhai Raghunathki | jab sadguru pakde hath ||28||
adha mata sadhka | jahan Parbrahmki aas ||
poora mata tahan Jivana | jahan sadguru shabd vishvas ||29||
man guru charne arpiye | tan hai kul pach mahin ||
Brahmadik bhule Jivana | yun harijan kahavat nahin ||30||
tan man arpe Ramkun | to de Vaikunthko dham ||
guru charne arpe Jivana | to charan kamal vishram ||31||
matha vohona manavi | kahan dekhe Jivandas ||
guru charne shish sompke | jagse rahe udas ||32||
asht sidh nav nidh Jivana | jahan sadguru shabd vishvas ||
sol kalasun Shamlo | jahan Harike nij das ||33||

|| sakhi bhetki ||
sadguru Jivan umge | shyam ghata ghan ghor ||
ajhar jhare ras pijiye | so nirkhat jugal kishor ||34||

|| sakhi shri mukhki ||
vede rundhi vatdi | mukti bhaktiko ghat ||
guru parsade Jivana | maar udadi laat ||35||
vaat ughadi nisaryo | sant samagam mahin ||
bhavsagar tar Jivana | Sitapatiki banhi ||36||
mukh vedanko marke | ankhan dini dhool ||
guru parsade Jivana | jai pakdo nij mool ||37||
samran sadguru Jivana | jine moh todyo vedo tano ||
sakal dharma shir upare | akal lekh santo tano ||38||
lakhya mite nahi Jivana | je kachhu lakhiya lekh ||
sadguru lekh mitaiya | tab paya aap alekh ||39||
alakh lakhayo Jivana | sadguru Sitaram ||
karma dharma vede kahyo | so chhand diyo bekaam ||40||
Ram Ram sab kahat hai | pan sat naam hi saar ||
anami naam payo Jivana | sadguruke upgar ||41||
sat Ram sab ko kahe | asat na kaheve koi ||
guru kripa bin Jivana | sat te asat hoi ||42||
Krishna kripathi ko taryo | guru kripathi chor ||
jug jug bhatke Jivana | jyun dhani vihona dhor ||43||
bhavsagarmaan Jivana | bohot pari hai bhir ||
sadguru sandesho yun kahyo | tum vege aao Raghuvir ||44||
je je kar bhayo Jivana | jab sadguru diya updesh ||
bhavsagarmaan boodtan | kar grahi kadhe kesh ||45||
hira vanaja Jivana | jab sadguru bhaye dalal ||
parkhat parkhat parkhiya | je Ramnaam tattvasar ||46||
Hari hiraki kotdi | sadguru diya batay ||
sant samagam jhilvo | je Raghuvar dulaho gay ||47||
rajas tamas sattvik | e tin gunmen sansar ||
chothe gunko Jivana | so sadguruko parivar ||48||
matvalasa dekhiye | guru shabde maimant ||
tun mat darpe Jivana | shir upar Kamla kant ||49||
shir sateka khel hai | khel sake to aav ||
lalopata nahi Jivana | sadguru batayo daav ||50||
patra kupatra Jivana | sadguru dey batay ||
nik shish Vibhishan namyo | Raghupati bhaye sahay ||51||
sacha sadguru jab mile | tab aapa dey uthay ||
je marag sant nikse Jivana | so marag dey batay ||52||
sacha sadguru jab mile | tab bhayo naam vishvas ||
virah agan-se Jivana | bhayo karmko naash ||53||
kooto pado ab Jivana | jap tap tirath daan ||
saar sadguruki vahe gai | kaat kiyo medan ||54||
kheti sooki Jivana | saro na pako koy ||
oogi pan sinchi nahi | guru shabd bin toy ||55||
moh pasaryo manani | sab jag gayo garkay ||
harijan ubre Jivana | khele sadguruko daav ||56||
sadguru Jivan Shyamlo | Das Kabirji Ram ||
Ramanandke sikhmaan | Kabir Ram sukh dham ||57||
Ramanandi sampradaymaan | uda Jivandas ||
kul karma karni taji | kari Ram charanki aas ||58||
uda kudya Jivana | jap tap tirath daan ||
ved marag pichhe rahyun | jai malya Hari naam ||59||
uda kudya Jivana | dini ekaj phal ||
sant samagammaan malyo | jahan Ayodhya tano mahipal ||60||
translation:
|| Here begins the section on the Guru-Deva (the divine Guru) ||

1. My name is Jivan; I was born in the Kanbi (farmer) lineage. My Lord is Ramji, and my sadguru (true guru) is Das Gopal.

2. Sadguru Das Gopalji, who is an incarnation of the line of Janak. He showed Jivan Raghupati (Ram, lord of the Raghus), who is the adornment of Vrishabhanu's daughter (Radha).

3. Choose a guru with careful thought - one who will show you Ram: Ram of the bank of the Sarayu, of the city and township of Ayodhya.

4. My Lord is Ramji, whose brothers are Bharat and Shatrughna; with Sankarshan (Lakshman) and with Janki (Sita) at his side - Jivan, he is the father of this world.

5. The sadguru made me understand, Jivan, and then the mind became steady. "I found the milk and went round the temple" - so said Das Kabir.

6. What had never been seen and never been heard, the sadguru pointed out. Now why do you lie sleeping, Jivan? Sing a little of the spotless Name.

7. Let go of the world and the Vedas; let go of earth and sky. Abide in the sadguru's word, Jivan, where the light of love and bhakti (devotion) shines.

8. The one and only is great bliss; the second is the sadguru, the supporting vine; the third is Raghupati, Jivan - with the Name, make your sport.

9. All turned out well, Jivan, when the sadguru took hold of my hand. For countless births, without the name of Ram, I had embraced only the thorn tree.

10. The betel-roll of sixty-four leaves - the sadguru revealed it. This is the boon I ask, Jivan: the grace of the saints' feet.

11. What Ramanand spoke, Das Kabir heard; and the same the sadguru has told Jivan: worship Sitapati (Sita's lord), Raghuvir.

12. The essence hidden in the three worlds - the sadguru revealed it. The twenty-eight pits (hells), Jivan, he has freed his servant from.

13. The "ola jhola" was what the sadguru pointed out to Jivan: Raghupati, whom the Vedas kept concealed inside rites and duty (karma and dharma).

14. Father and forebears ("bapa badhu") are not to be forsaken - Kanhaiya (Krishna) at Yashoda's neck. The sadguru explained it, Jivan; then what is honour and what is comparison?

15. Opposition to the Veda arose, Jivan, when the sadguru became my helper. The Veda says: worship the formless Niranjan; but we sing of Raghuvar as the bridegroom.

16. Make your birth fruitful, Jivan - repeat the name of Sitapati. The Veda spoke of a form of pure light, but by it not one purpose was accomplished.

17. No one is your own, Jivan - I have looked through my own land and foreign lands. There is only the shelter of Sitapati, or the teaching of the sadguru.

18. What can the poor guru do if the disciple is arrogant and dull? Give milk-pudding to a dog, Jivan - it will not stay in his belly for a moment.

19. He became a devotee of Hari out of mere enthusiasm, and the guru he found was a fool. Like matched with like, Jivan - as a donkey rolls in ashes.

20. Slowly, slowly, Jivan - the way a chameleon moves its feet. Now, leaving my own country, I have taken up the "vea"; the sadguru said, "Come."

21. Yama (death) was proved false, Jivan, when the sadguru gave his testimony: "This one is your own soul - Raghupati, take him into your keeping."

22. The sadguru's word became the stake of trial, and the saints became the guardians. I will not let it be, Jivan - a Creator without support (a formless God).

|| Sakhis (couplets) of the meeting ||

23. The sadguru is stubborn, Jivan - he plays his own move. Wherever he sees ego (aapa), there he plants his foot.

24. The sadguru stands with steel in hand, sounding the drum and banner of the Name. Ego trembled and shook, and fled wherever it could, Jivan.

|| Sakhis from the holy mouth ||

25. Everyone says "guru, guru", but the body's bondage is not wiped away. The Holy Mouth says: listen, Jivan - the guru is the valiant one of the field (Khetaiya).

26. It all comes to a zero, Jivan, if I do service to some other god. The sadguru declared the very truth-essence: Raghupati is the true God.

27. The meaning of the sadguru's teaching is entry into the Name. When the ocean of existence is wiped away, Jivan, we shall come to that land.

28. In the swing of Hari, Jivan, I forgot all other company. The grace of Raghunath came when the sadguru took hold of my hand.

29. Half-formed is the seeker's doctrine where the hope rests on Parbrahm (the impersonal Supreme). The full doctrine is there, Jivan, where there is trust in the sadguru's word.

30. Offer the mind at the guru's feet; the body stays among the family and the five (elements). Brahma and the other gods went astray, Jivan - in that way one is not called a devotee of Hari.

31. Offer body and mind to Ram, and he gives you the abode of Vaikunth. Offer them at the guru's feet, Jivan, and you find rest at the lotus feet.

32. A man without a head - where does Jivandas see one? He who has handed over his head at the guru's feet and stays detached from the world.

33. The eight siddhis and the nine treasures are there, Jivan, where there is trust in the sadguru's word. The dark Lord with his sixteen kalas (full digits of power) is where Hari's own servants are.

|| Sakhis of the meeting ||

34. Sadguru and Jivan surge with joy, like dark clouds massing thick. Drink the nectar that trickles from the unfailing spring, gazing on the youthful divine pair.

|| Sakhis from the holy mouth ||

35. The Veda blocked up the little path, the landing-place of liberation and devotion. By the guru's grace, Jivan, a kick sent it flying.

36. The path opened and I came out into the company of the saints. Cross the ocean of existence, Jivan, by the arm of Sitapati.

37. Striking the mouth of the Vedas and throwing dust in their eyes - by the guru's grace, Jivan, go and take hold of your own root.

38. Remember the sadguru, Jivan, who broke the spell of the Vedas. Above all religion stands the unfathomable writ of the saints.

39. What is written is not erased, Jivan - whatever destiny has been written. The sadguru erased the writing; then I found the One beyond all writing (alekh).

40. The sadguru showed the unseeable (alakh), Jivan - Sitaram. The rites and duties the Veda prescribed, I threw away as useless.

41. Everyone says "Ram, Ram", but the true Name alone is the essence. I obtained the name of the Nameless, Jivan, by the sadguru's kindness.

42. Everyone calls Ram true; no one calls him false. But without the guru's grace, Jivan, the true turns into the false.

43. Who has crossed over by Krishna's grace? By the guru's grace even a thief crosses. Otherwise one wanders age after age, Jivan, like cattle without an owner.

44. In the ocean of existence, Jivan, great distress has come. The sadguru sent this message: "Come quickly, Raghuvir."

45. Cries of victory rose, Jivan, when the sadguru gave his teaching. As I was drowning in the ocean of existence, he seized me and pulled me out by the hair.

46. Trade in diamonds, Jivan, now that the sadguru has become the broker. Testing and testing I have tested it: the name of Ram is the essence of the essence.

47. The sadguru pointed out the chamber of Hari's diamonds. Bathe in the company of the saints, who sing of Raghuvar as the bridegroom.

48. Rajas, tamas, sattva - the world lies within these three qualities. The fourth quality, Jivan, belongs to the sadguru's household.

49. They look like drunkards, intoxicated with the guru's word. Do not be afraid, Jivan - Kamala's lord (Hari) is over your head.

50. This is a game staked on the head; come, if you can play it. There is no coaxing here, Jivan - the sadguru has shown the move.

51. Who is worthy and who unworthy, Jivan - the sadguru points it out. Vibhishan bowed his head well and humbly, and Raghupati became his help.

52. When the true sadguru is met, he lifts the ego away. The road by which the saints have gone out, Jivan - that road he shows.

53. When the true sadguru is met, trust in the Name is born. By the fire of longing separation (virah), Jivan, karma is destroyed.

54. Let them lie beaten aside now, Jivan - repetition, austerity, pilgrimage, charity. The sadguru's blade swept through and cut the field clear.

55. The crop dried up, Jivan; nothing ripened well. It sprouted, but it was never watered - without the water of the guru's word.

56. Delusion spread out over the proud, and the whole world went under. The devotees of Hari were saved, Jivan, playing the sadguru's move.

57. For Jivan the sadguru is the dark Lord himself; for Das Kabirji he is Ram. Among Ramanand's disciples, Kabir found Ram, the abode of bliss.

58. In the Ramanandi sampraday (tradition), Jivandas soared. He gave up caste, rites and observances, and set his hope on Ram's feet.

59. He flew and leapt, Jivan, clear over repetition, austerity, pilgrimage and charity. The path of the Veda was left behind, and he went and found the Name of Hari.

60. He flew and leapt, Jivan - he made one single bound. In the company of the saints he found him: the king of Ayodhya.
